recognize_zh: 密集的漿細胞樣細胞（核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀、細胞質嗜雙染色）成片浸潤並分隔粉紅色平滑肌束，形成破壞性腫塊，於移植病人背景下符合漿細胞瘤樣 PTLD。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate dissecting eosinophilic smooth muscle bundles
Monotonous plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Clock-face to vesicular chromatin; some cells larger with visible nucleoli
Occasional binucleate or enlarged atypical plasma cells
Scattered small vessels; no germinal centers or polymorphous inflammatory background evident
describe_en: Sections show a dense, destructive infiltrate of plasma cells and plasmacytoid cells that dissects through smooth muscle bundles. The cells have eccentric round nuclei, clumped to vesicular chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with scattered larger atypical forms. The infiltrate is monotonous without a polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes or eosinophils. In a transplant recipient, with EBER positivity and light-chain restriction, findings are consistent with monomorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, plasmacytoma-like type.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytic hyperplasia preserves architecture and is polytypic, whereas this infiltrate is destructive and monotypic.
Plasmablastic lymphoma consists of large immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli and high Ki-67, rather than predominantly mature-appearing plasma cells.
Polymorphic PTLD shows a full spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasma cells and immunoblasts with CD20+ B cells, not a monotonous plasma cell sheet.

ddx.dx: Extramedullary spread of plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Myeloma requires marrow involvement, serum/urine M-protein and CRAB features, and is usually EBV-negative.
